title: Current-day school brief with after-last-class and IEP coverage

dependency_checks: Resolve private source, output, account and executor bindings; unresolved required bindings block dependent work.
Verify current authorization, tested capabilities and one shared writer lease, including independent external sessions.
Read exact source revisions and completeness; unavailable or partial sources never establish no work.
Preserve prior complete state and reconcile uncertain output with its original request ID before any repeat write.
Recovered native policy requires today school-day review from connected home and school calendars/email; backend timezone and output receipt remain unverified.
Identify actual classes and last-class end time from current evidence, then determine what is scheduled afterward; do not substitute generic after-school assumptions.
Explicitly resolve whether IEP coverage or a covering meeting exists today, with time and relevant details when found; unavailable coverage remains unknown, never none.
Read school email from the past 24 hours for changes to today schedule, coverage, meetings or responsibilities; retain exact source links and current date.
Keep the brief concise and action-oriented; compare same-date source/output with local day review before coordinator selects one owner.
Do not import the local day-review two-business-day mail window or silently disable either existing owner.

success_checks: Brief identifies today classes, verified last-class end time and following commitments; unresolved boundary or calendar coverage is explicit.
IEP coverage/covering-meeting status is explicit with sourced time/details, or an explicit unknown when the required evidence is inaccessible.
Relevant past-24-hour school-mail changes are incorporated without replying or editing events; one existing-task output is read back.
Record exact request, source revisions, output hash and native destination readback; label remaining coverage gaps.
